## component.add

Adds a component to an entity (or to every one of the entities) where it is missing and sets the given property values, in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:639`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | string | yes |   | Component type. |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entities (instead of entity) (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |
| `entity` | string | no |   | Entity (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `values` | object | no |   | Property values. |

## component.get

The property values of one component of an entity: {values}, and inactive: {Property: reason} for properties that have no effect in the component's state (e.g. the procedural sky's colors while Source is EnvironmentMap; left out when none).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:700`

## component.remove

Removes a component from an entity (or from every one of the entities, which must all have it), in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only).

## component.set

Sets property values of a component that the entity (or every one of the entities) has, in one undo step (while playing it changes the running copy only). Invalid values change nothing. Returns the component's values (of the first entity).

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scene` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/EntityCommands.cpp:721`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | string | yes |   | Component type. |
| `entities` | array of string | no |   | Entities to set the same values on (instead of entity) (entity IDs). Items: at least 1. |
| `entity` | string | no |   | Entity (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `values` | object | yes |   | Property values, e.g. {&quot;Intensity&quot;: 2}. |
